app.name: Kniho-hlod
app.tagline: Your library, and who has borrowed what.
app.updateReady: A new version of Kniho-hlod is ready.
app.updateHint: It loads once you reload the page.

common.somethingWentWrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.conflict: This clashed with another change. Reload the page and try again.

auth.forgotPasswordHint: We'll email you a link to set a new password.
auth.forgotPasswordSent: If an account with that email exists, we've sent it a link.
auth.resetPasswordDone: Your password has been changed, you can sign in.
auth.resetPasswordInvalid: This link is no longer valid. Please request a new one.
auth.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please try again shortly.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired, please sign in again.

account.title: Account
account.reminderDaysBefore: Remind me days before the due date
account.avatarHint: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB.
account.deleteAccountHint: Deletes your account with all your books and loans. This cannot be undone.
account.remindersHint: We'll e-mail you when a lent book is nearly due back, then once a week while it's overdue.

home.empty: Your library is empty so far. Add your first book — its ISBN is enough.
home.nothingDue: Nothing is overdue and nothing is due back in the next few days.

books.title: Books
books.deleteConfirm: Really delete “{title}”? Its loan history goes too. This cannot be undone.
books.savedWithoutCover: The book has been saved, but its cover could not be uploaded.
books.empty: No books here yet. Add your first one — its ISBN is enough.
books.emptyFiltered: No book matches the search and filters.
books.search: Search by title, author or ISBN
books.isbnLookupHint: We fill in the title, author and cover from the Czech libraries’ catalogue, Open Library or Google Books.
books.isbnFilled: We filled in the details from the catalogue. Check them and save.
books.isbnNotFound: The catalogues don't know this ISBN. Please fill in the book yourself.
books.isbnUnavailable: The book catalogues can't be reached right now. Try again later, or fill in the book yourself.
books.isbnInvalid: This is not a valid ISBN. Check it for a typo.
books.coverHint: JPG, PNG or WebP. We scale it down to at most 1000 px.
books.coverTooLarge: That image is too large, please pick one under 20 MB.
books.coverFromCatalogue: Cover from the catalogue — saved together with the book.
books.deleteBlockedByLoan: A lent book cannot be deleted. Mark it returned first.
books.notesPlaceholder: What you liked, a quote, who to recommend it to…
books.savedWithoutShelves: The book is saved, but its shelves could not be changed.
books.duplicate: This book is in your library already: “{title}”.

validation.type: This value has the wrong format.
validation.enum: Pick one of the offered options.
validation.reference: The selected item does not exist.
validation.after: The end must come after the start.

loans.title: Loans
loans.deleteConfirm: Delete the record of lending “{title}”? This cannot be undone.
loans.alreadyLent: This book is already lent out.

empty.active: Nothing is lent out right now.
empty.returned: No book has come back yet.

loans.pickBookHint: Showing the books you have at home.
loans.noBooksAtHome: There is no book at home to lend right now.
loans.pickContact: Choose a contact or type a new name
loans.contactHint: Just type a new name — the contact is created with the loan.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.deleteConfirm: Really delete the contact “{name}”? Their loan history goes too.
contacts.deleteBlocked: A contact cannot be deleted while they have a book.
contacts.empty: No contacts yet. They appear when you lend someone a book.
contacts.search: Search by name, e-mail or phone
contacts.nothingBorrowed: Has nothing of yours right now.

shelves.title: Shelves
shelves.hint: Group your books your way — favourites, to give away, the kids’ room. A book can be on several shelves.
shelves.emptyShelf: Nothing on this shelf yet. Put a book on it from the book’s form.
shelves.deleteConfirm: Delete the shelf “{name}”? The books stay in your library, only off this shelf.
shelves.pickHint: Type a name to create a new shelf.
shelves.searchOrCreate: Search or type a new one

scanner.title: Scan the ISBN
scanner.description: The barcode is on the back of the book.
scanner.hint: Point the camera at the ISBN barcode and hold it still for a moment.
scanner.cameraDenied: Kniho-hlod may not use the camera. Allow it in your browser settings, or type the ISBN.
scanner.noCamera: No camera found. Please type the ISBN.
scanner.cameraBusy: Another app is using the camera. Close it and try again.
scanner.cameraFailed: The camera would not start. Please type the ISBN.
scanner.readerFailed: The barcode reader would not load. Check your connection, or type the ISBN.

install.title: Kniho-hlod as an app
install.description: Install Kniho-hlod on your home screen. It opens as an app of its own, with ISBN scanning at hand.
install.shareMenuSteps: In Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.hint: Messages for everyone, such as planned maintenance

users.title: Users
users.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}'s account ({email})? All their books, contacts and loans go with it. This can't be undone.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.hint: An announcement shows to everyone, in the app and on the sign-in page, while it runs.
